column1: # Relative token frequency per phoneme, by inventory.token_class (PW-1623): the median over NorthEuraLex 0.9's
# languages (Dellert et al. 2020, CC-BY 4.0) of a class's share of its kind's tokens, per phoneme of the class,
# over the average phoneme of the kind (1.0 = average). Built by tools/language/token_priors.py; classes in
# fewer than 20 languages left out. Eurasian sample: a lexical prior, not a world average.
# initial (PW-1686): the class's share of word-initial tokens of its kind over its share of all its kind's
# tokens, median over the languages (word starts favour p h k m, disfavour l n r ŋ).
